description: Source code for the PlayerWorker class implementation, managing media playback tasks such as initialization, seeking, writing samples, and error handling within a media player framework.

classes.name: PlayerWorker
classes.description: Manages media playback operations in a dedicated thread, including initialization, seeking, writing samples, and error reporting.

classes.name: ThreadParam
classes.description: Holds thread parameters including synchronization primitives and a reference to the PlayerWorker instance.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new PlayerWorker instance if thread creation succeeds.

methods.name: UpdateMediaInfo
methods.description: Updates media information such as current time, dropped frames, and progress status.

methods.name: UpdatePlayerState
methods.description: Updates the player's current state and notifies via callback.

methods.name: UpdatePlayerError
methods.description: Reports an error encountered during playback, ensuring only the first error is reported.

methods.name: ThreadEntryPoint
methods.description: Entry point for the worker thread, sets thread name and priority, initializes job queue, and runs the main loop.

methods.name: RunLoop
methods.description: Main loop that runs until stopped, handling media tasks.

methods.name: DoInit
methods.description: Initializes the handler and updates player state accordingly.

methods.name: DoSeek
methods.description: Performs seek operation to a specified timestamp, updating decoder states.

methods.name: DoWriteSamples
methods.description: Writes input buffers to the media pipeline, managing pending buffers and scheduling pending writes.

methods.name: DoWritePendingSamples
methods.description: Handles scheduled writing of pending audio and video buffers.

methods.name: DoWriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream for a given media type.

methods.name: DoStop
methods.description: Stops the handler and cleans up resources, updating state to destroyed.
